question: cp-9 中系统组件参数代表什么？
answer:
cp-09_odp.01 指定备份用户级信息涉及的系统组件，其余 cp-09_odp.02、03、04 是备份频率参数。
【出处】[资料1]《NIST SP 800-53 5.2.0 OSCAL》定位【cp-9】

System backups reflect the requirements in contingency plans as well as other organizational requirements for backing up information.
